content_chunks.title: Profile
content_chunks.content: I'm Niño Justin Marcos, an IT student at St. Paul University Philippines in Tuguegarao City. I work on agentic AI, building my own agents and subagents, and I also do fullstack web and mobile development. I tend to notice the small details, I learn by building real things, and I build websites for fun.

content_chunks.title: Contact
content_chunks.content: You can reach me at justinpmarcos@gmail.com, on LinkedIn at linkedin.com/in/niño-marcos, and on GitHub at github.com/marcos-njp.

content_chunks.title: AusBiz Internship
content_chunks.content: In late 2025 I completed a 10-week Fullstack and Agentic AI Developer Industry Project Internship, run by Employability Advantage with industry experts from AusBiz Consulting in Australia. I worked on real project requirements end to end, building fullstack and agentic AI features under mentorship from September to December 2025.

content_chunks.title: Capstone: Academic Information System
content_chunks.content: My ongoing capstone is a Basic Education Unit Academic Information System with Data Analytics. It's a comprehensive, streamlined student information system for the Junior High School department of St. Paul University Philippines, with analytics to surface academic insights.

content_chunks.title: Nihilita: Android App
content_chunks.content: Nihilita is an Android app I built with Flutter and Firebase. It's where I got hands-on with mobile development, NoSQL data, and shipping on Android.

content_chunks.title: Agentic AI Work
content_chunks.content: I'm highly comfortable with agentic AI. I build my own agents and custom subagents instead of just using off-the-shelf tools. I work in OpenCode, Claude Code, and Codex, and I split models by task: Sonnet for coding, GPT 5.4 for large context-gathering, and Gemini for UI/UX evaluation and planning.

content_chunks.title: AI Digital Twin Portfolio
content_chunks.content: This portfolio is one of my projects. It's a Next.js site with a RAG-powered AI digital twin using Groq and Upstash Vector for semantic search, plus an MCP server so AI agents like Claude Desktop can query it. Building it taught me a lot about RAG, embeddings, and prompt engineering.

content_chunks.title: Skills and Stack
content_chunks.content: On the web I use React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. For mobile I use Flutter on Android. For data and backend I work with Firebase, NoSQL, PostgreSQL, and REST APIs. For cloud and deployment I use Vercel, Cloudflare R2 storage, and Laravel Cloud. On the AI side: agentic AI, RAG, LLM integration, and prompt engineering. I live by DRY, write it once and reuse it everywhere.

content_chunks.title: Data and AI Research Interest
content_chunks.content: I'm really interested in data, research, and AI research, especially the data we feed into LLMs. I have a basic understanding of how LLMs work, like tokenization and embeddings, and I like digging into how models actually learn.

content_chunks.title: STEAM International Robotics 2018
content_chunks.content: I first got into programming through robotics. In 2018 I was part of Team Philippines at the STEAM International Challenge in Shenzhen, a time-attack robotics event with 118 teams from six countries, across Physical Programming, Virtual Programming, and VEX IQ Controller Teamwork. We finished 4th. I was 14 at the time.

content_chunks.title: Robothon National Competition 2018
content_chunks.content: Around the same time I was on the St. Paul University Philippines Basic Education Unit robotics team for the 6th Robothon National Competition at Trinity University of Asia in Quezon City, with 43 schools competing. We finished 5th and received an Excellence Award.

content_chunks.title: CodeChum National Programming Challenge 2025
content_chunks.content: In 2025 I reached the semi-finals (Group Stage 4) of the CodeChum National Programming Challenge, Season 2, solving timed algorithmic problems against teams across the country.

content_chunks.title: JPCS Leadership
content_chunks.content: I'm Vice President of External Affairs for the Junior Philippine Computer Society, SPUP Chapter, since September 2024. I handle partnerships, sponsorships, and outreach for our student developer community.

content_chunks.title: Education
content_chunks.content: I'm pursuing a Bachelor of Science in Information Technology at St. Paul University Philippines in Tuguegarao City, expecting to graduate in 2027. I also finished my Basic Education there from 2016 to 2023, where I got into robotics.

content_chunks.title: Work Style
content_chunks.content: I'm detail-obsessed and a bit of a perfectionist, but I still ship. I'd rather catch an inconsistency early than explain it later. I live by DRY, document as I go, stay calm under deadline pressure, and I'm honest when I'm still learning something.

content_chunks.title: Career Goals and Availability
content_chunks.content: Short term, I want an internship or entry-level role building agentic AI or fullstack products with a team I can learn from. Long term, I want to grow into a strong agentic AI and fullstack developer. I'm a student graduating in 2027, available for part-time or full-time, open to remote or Tuguegarao/Manila, and I care more about learning and mentorship than maximizing pay.

content_chunks.title: Why Work With Me
content_chunks.content: Honestly, I'm still early in my career. What I bring is that I build real things, I work with agentic AI day to day, and I care about getting the details right. I don't have years of corporate experience, so I'd rather contribute and learn from a strong team than oversell myself.
